tags.description: Validation interface that will request authorization of booking based on the data provided at checkout time.This is only an example. The path and the host are specific for each implementor. However, the model is fixed and versioned.
tags.name: validation

error_fields.name: Project Code
error_fields.error_description: The Project Code is unknown, please try another value.

error_fields.name: Travel Request Id
error_fields.error_description: Travel Request or Mission Number Not Found.Please verify your entry or create a new Travel Request or Mission Number and request its approval before booking on Egencia.

200.description: Ok : Booking request will be granted. Booking will happen.

400.description: Bad Request : Booking will not happen. The User will be blocked in Checkout page.

401.description: Unauthorized : Authentication Failure. Booking will not happen. The User will be blocked in Checkout page with a message telling the User to contact his system administrator as there was an error with his internal software.

403.description: Forbidden : Booking will not happen. The User will be blocked in Checkout page with a message telling the User to contact his system administrator as there was an error with his internal software.

500.description: Internal Server Error : Booking will not happen. The User will be blocked in Checkout page with a message telling the User to contact his system administrator as there was an error with the internal software.

email.description: The email address of the person who is doing the booking.

is_agent.description: Flag indicating if an Egencia Travel Consultant/Agent is doing the booking.

is_arranger.description: Flag indicating if the booker has the arranger role (An arranger can arrange booking for other persons).

user_id.description: TUID (Egencia Travelers Unique Identifier) of the user who is doing the booking.

language.description:
The ISO 639-1 Code two letters language code. This value is passed in the request.
This is the language that the user uses on Egencia website.

Error messages shall match this language.

partner_customer_code.description: The partner_customer_code is the unique identifier of a client in the application of the partner. For partners who request it, partner_customer_code must be set everytime a customer subscribes to those partners.

request_timestamp.description: UTC Time stamp of the request ISO-8601. The format is the following:"yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ"

travelers.description: The list of Travelers that included in that booking request and could be validated.

trip_info.description: Placeholder that can accommodate trip Information.

items.description: Placeholder that can accommodate trip Information.

errors.description: The List of errors for the traveler.

valid.description: The value describes whether validation was successful or failure.

error_fields.description: The list of field which are not valid.

user_id.description: TUID (Egencia Travelers Unique Identifier) of the traveler.

error_description.description:
The error description provided by the Consumer in the language specified in the request.
This messages will be displayed to the user so that he can understand and correct the information in the form.

expected_value.description: The expected value for the field. Currently not supported in this version.

name.description: The name of field which is not valid.

user_id.description: TUID (Egencia Travelers Unique Identifier) of the traveler.

validation_fields.description: The list of the fields and their corresponding values which needs to be validated.

name.description: The name of field which needs to be validated for.

value.description: The Value of the corresponding field.
